title: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth (Repentance+)
provenance: Reported by phs1997 (highball-db#119, 2026-09-18) playing the Repentance+ expansion: rated 3, playable with workarounds, on DXMT, Apple M2 Max, macOS 27.0, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5, Highball 0.9.27, 97 minutes played through Highball. The workaround, added in a follow-up comment: when the game starts lagging, restarting it helps a lot. Not run here.
notes: Steam 250900 is the Rebirth base game; Repentance+ is its expansion and what the one report played. Playable for a 97-minute session on DXMT. The one workaround reported is that performance degrades over a long session and restarting the game brings it back; frame rate is not recorded yet.

knownIssues.symptom: Slows down after a while of play (reported on DXMT, M2 Max, macOS 27, engine r5)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed; reported as lag building up over a long session
knownIssues.fix: Quit the game and start it again, the reporter says that helps a lot
